nodes.name: actions.ts
nodes.summary: Server actions for the Inventar (physical valuables) feature: create/update/delete valuables, record valuations, and manage uploaded images (register, promote to main image, delete) via Supabase.
nodes.languageNotes: Next.js Server Actions ("use server") with small FormData-parsing helpers (text/zahl/schalter) shared across create and update.

nodes.name: felder
nodes.summary: Parses and validates raw FormData for a valuable into a typed field object shared by createValuable and updateValuable.

nodes.name: createValuable
nodes.summary: Server action that creates a new valuable and its initial purchase valuation in Supabase for the authenticated user.

nodes.name: updateValuable
nodes.summary: Server action that updates a valuable's fields, recalculates the active valuation, and revalidates the inventory page.

nodes.name: addValuation
nodes.summary: Server action that records a new worth estimate (valuation) for an existing valuable.

nodes.name: registerValuableImage
nodes.summary: Server action that registers an uploaded image (photo, receipt, or generated artwork) for a valuable, enforcing a per-item image limit.

nodes.name: setHauptbild
nodes.summary: Server action that marks one image as the main display image for a valuable.

nodes.name: deleteValuableImage
nodes.summary: Server action that deletes an image from storage and the database, promoting another image to main if the deleted one was primary.

nodes.name: deleteValuable
nodes.summary: Server action that deletes a valuable together with all of its stored image files.

nodes.name: page.tsx
nodes.summary: Server Component for the Inventar (physical assets) dashboard page: loads the user's valuables and images, signs image URLs, computes portfolio totals/returns, and renders the inventory client view.

nodes.name: InventarPage
nodes.summary: Default-exported page component that fetches valuables and images for the current user, signs image URLs, computes total value and return metrics, and passes everything to InventoryClient.

nodes.name: Kennzahl
nodes.summary: Small presentational component rendering a labeled key metric (value + optional hint) in the page header.

nodes.name: actions.ts
nodes.summary: Server actions for the trading Strategy/Indicators feature: CRUD for indicators and their backtest performance records in Supabase.

nodes.name: createIndicator
nodes.summary: Server action that creates a new trading indicator record for the authenticated user.

nodes.name: updateIndicator
nodes.summary: Server action that updates an existing indicator (name, author, type, forbidden status, notes, code).

nodes.name: deleteIndicator
nodes.summary: Server action that deletes an indicator owned by the current user.

nodes.name: parseOptFloat
nodes.summary: Parses an optional numeric field from FormData, returning null on empty/invalid input.

nodes.name: parseOptDate
nodes.summary: Parses an optional date field from FormData, returning null when blank.

nodes.name: createPerformance
nodes.summary: Server action that creates a backtest performance record (win rate, Sharpe/Sortino, drawdown, etc.) for an indicator.

nodes.name: updatePerformance
nodes.summary: Server action that updates an existing backtest performance record.

nodes.name: deletePerformance
nodes.summary: Server action that deletes a backtest performance record.

nodes.name: AthenaSettingsForm.tsx
nodes.summary: Client form for configuring the Athena AI assistant's persona, model, reasoning effort, and custom persona text/toggles, saved via a server action.

nodes.name: ToggleField
nodes.summary: Reusable labeled toggle/checkbox field with its own local checked state, used for Athena behavior switches.

nodes.name: AthenaSettingsForm
nodes.summary: Exported client component rendering the full Athena settings form (persona picker, model/effort selects, persona text editor, toggles) and submitting changes via saveAthenaSettings.

nodes.name: KnowledgeManager.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component for managing Athena's knowledge base entries: create/edit/pin/delete entries with tag support, calling the assistant server actions.

nodes.name: KnowledgeManager
nodes.summary: Exported client component listing knowledge entries and providing create/edit/pin/delete flows via server actions, with tag display and expandable entries.

nodes.name: MemoryManager.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component for managing Athena's persistent memory entries grouped by category, supporting create/edit/delete via server actions.

nodes.name: MemoryManager
nodes.summary: Exported client component listing memory entries by category and providing create/edit/delete flows via upsertMemory/deleteMemory server actions.

nodes.name: asset-form.tsx
nodes.summary: Client form components for creating, editing, and deleting crypto portfolio assets (coin, amount, portfolio) via server actions.

nodes.name: AssetFields
nodes.summary: Shared form fields for a crypto asset (coin combobox, amount, portfolio) reused by create and edit dialogs.

nodes.name: AssetDialog
nodes.summary: Shared dialog wrapper handling open state and form submission for creating or editing a crypto asset.

nodes.name: AssetFormDialog
nodes.summary: Exported dialog for adding a new crypto asset to a portfolio.

nodes.name: DeleteAssetButton
nodes.summary: Exported button + confirmation dialog that deletes a crypto asset via the deleteAsset server action.

nodes.name: account-form.tsx
nodes.summary: Client form components for creating, editing, and deleting finance accounts (type, currency, balance) via server actions.

nodes.name: AccountFields
nodes.summary: Shared form fields for an account (name, type, currency, opening balance) reused by add and edit dialogs.

nodes.name: AccountDialog
nodes.summary: Shared dialog wrapper handling create/edit submission for an account via server actions.

nodes.name: DeleteAccountButton
nodes.summary: Exported button + confirmation dialog that deletes an account via the deleteAccount server action.

nodes.name: category-form.tsx
nodes.summary: Client form dialogs for creating, editing, and deleting transaction categories, including parent category, tax role, and EÜR line assignment.

nodes.name: CategoryFormFields
nodes.summary: Shared form fields for a category (type, parent category, tax role, EÜR line) reused by add and edit dialogs.

nodes.name: AddCategoryDialog
nodes.summary: Exported dialog for creating a new transaction category via the createCategory server action.

nodes.name: EditCategoryDialog
nodes.summary: Exported dialog for editing an existing category via the updateCategory server action.

nodes.name: DeleteCategoryButton
nodes.summary: Exported button + confirmation dialog that deletes a category via the deleteCategory server action.
